title: Arvinis Chest Log
description: This Plugin adds a chest log menu for Server Op so you can see who took what and when and where
body:
Arvini’s Chest Log – Feature Description
Arvini’s Chest Log is a tracking menu that records every interaction players have with a shared chest. The log displays a clear, chronological list of who opened the chest and exactly what items they took or deposited. Each entry shows the player’s name, the item involved, the amount changed, and the time of the action.

The menu is designed for quick navigation, letting players scroll through past activity, filter by player, or search for specific items. Whether you’re managing a community storage chest or keeping an eye on valuable loot, Arvini’s Chest Log provides full transparency and helps prevent confusion or disputes over missing items.
